fact: Government bill no. 040/2026, deposited at the National Assembly on 28 August 2026, would require data generated or collected in Madagascar to be stored in the country (a copy may go abroad if the original stays) and data centre providers to be certified, per the GSMA's summary of articles 8-11.
title: L'économie numérique à Madagascar : les réformes de politique publique qui façonneront l'avenir numérique de Madagascar
